pages.text: The Khamsin Curse has 5 stages:$(br2)Stage 1: Weakness$(br)Stage 2: Hunger drain$(br)Stage 3: Mining fatigue$(br)Stage 4: Wither effect$(br)Stage 5: Rapid death!$(br2)You get cursed by walking on Cursed Earth or being attacked by cursed enemies.
Cursed Earth spreads and corrupts normal blocks. Cursed plants grow on it.$(br2)Avoid cursed areas or use Salt to protect yourself!
